source.title: Revelation of Esdras
source.breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Revelation of Esdras

paragraphs.text: Word and Revelation of Esdras, the Holy Prophet and Beloved of God.

It came to pass in the thirtieth year, on the twenty-second of the month, I was in my house. And I cried out and said to the Most High: Lord, give the glory, in order that I may see Your mysteries. And when it was night, there came an angel, Michael the archangel, and says to me: O Prophet Esdras, refrain from bread for seventy weeks. And I fasted as he told me. And there came Raphael the commander of the host, and gave me a storax rod. And I fasted twice sixty weeks. And I saw the mysteries of God and His angels. And I said to them: I wish to plead before God about the race of the Christians. It is good for a man not to be born rather than to come into the world. I was therefore taken up into heaven, and I saw in the first heaven a great army of angels; and they took me to the judgments. And I heard a voice saying to me: Have mercy on us, O you chosen of God, Esdras. Then began I to say: Woe to sinners when they see one who is just more than the angels, and they themselves are in the Gehenna of fire! And Esdras said: Have mercy on the works of Your hands, You who is compassionate, and of great mercy. Judge me rather than the souls of the sinners; for it is better that one soul should be punished, and that the whole world should not come to destruction. And God said: I will give rest in paradise to the righteous, and I have become merciful. And Esdras said: Lord, why do You confer benefits on the righteous? For just as one who has been hired out, and has served out his time, goes and again works as a slave when he come to his masters, so also the righteous has received his reward in the heavens. But have mercy on the sinners, for we know that You are merciful. And God said: I do not see how I can have mercy upon them. And Esdras said: They cannot endure Your wrath. And God said: This is the fate of such. And God said: I wish to have you like Paul and John, as you have given me uncorrupted the treasure that cannot be stolen, the treasure of virginity, the bulwark of men. And Esdras said: It is good for a man not to be born. It is good not to be in life. The irrational creatures are better than man, because they have no punishment; but You have taken us, and given us up to judgment. Woe to the sinners in the world to come! Because their judgment is endless, and the flame unquenchable. And while I was thus speaking to him, there came Michael and Gabriel, and all the apostles; and they said: Rejoice, O faithful man of God! And Esdras said: Arise, and come hither with me, O Lord, to judgment. And the Lord said: Behold, I give you my covenant between me and you, that you may receive it. And Esdras said: Let us plead in Your hearing. And God said: Ask Abraham your father how a son pleads with his father, and come plead with us. And Esdras said: As the Lord lives, I will not cease pleading with You in behalf of the race of the Christians. Where are Your ancient compassions, O Lord? Where is Your long-suffering? And God said: As I have made night and day, I have made the righteous and the sinner; and he should have lived like the righteous. And the prophet said: Who made Adam the first-formed? And God said: My undefiled hands. And I put him in paradise to guard the food of the tree of life; and thereafter he became disobedient, and did this in transgression. And the prophet said: Was he not protected by an angel? And was not his life guarded by the cherubim to endless ages? And how was he deceived who was guarded by angels? For You commanded all to be present, and to attend to what was said by You. But if You had not given him Eve, the serpent would not have deceived her; but whom You will You save, and whom You will You destroy. And the prophet said: Let us come, my Lord, to a second judgment. And God said: I cast fire upon Sodom and Gomorrha. And the prophet said: Lord, You deal with us according to our deserts. And God said: Your sins transcend my clemency. And the prophet said: Call to mind the Scriptures, my Father, who hast measured out Jerusalem, and set her up again. Have mercy, O Lord, upon sinners; have mercy upon Your own creatures; have pity upon Your works. Then God remembered those whom He had made, and said to the prophet: How can I have mercy upon them? Vinegar and gall did they give me to drink, {{BIBLE:mat 27:34}} and not even then did they repent. And the prophet said: Reveal Your cherubim, and let us go together to judgment; and show me the day of judgment, what like it is. And God said: You have been deceived, Esdras; for such is the day of judgment as that in which there is no rain upon the earth; for it is a merciful tribunal as compared with that day. And the prophet said: I will not cease to plead with You, unless I see the day of the consummation. And God said: Number the stars and the sand of the sea; and if you shall be able to number this, you are also able to plead with me. And the prophet said: Lord, You know that I wear human flesh; and how can I count the stars of the heaven, and the sand of the sea? And God said: My chosen prophet, no man will know that great day and the appearing that comes to judge the world. For your sake, my prophet, I have told you the day; but the hour have I not told you. And the prophet said: Lord, tell me also the years. And God said: If I see the righteousness of the world, that it has abounded, I will have patience with them; but if not, I will stretch forth my hand, and lay hold of the world by the four quarters, and bring them all together into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and I will wipe out the race of men, so that the world shall be no more. And the prophet said: And how can Your right hand be glorified? And God said: I shall be glorified by my angels. And the prophet said: Lord, if You have resolved to do this, why did You make man? Thou said to our father Abraham, {{BIBLE:gen 22:17}} Multiplying I will multiply your seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand that is by the sea-shore; and where is Your promise? And God said: First will I make an earthquake for the fall of four-footed beasts and of men; and when you see that brother gives up brother to death, and that children shall rise up against their parents, and that a woman forsakes her own husband, and when nation shall rise up against nation in war, then will you know that the end is near. {{NOTE:note082507}}

For then neither brother pities brother, nor man wife, nor children parents, nor friends friends, nor a slave his master; for he who is the adversary of men shall come up from Tartarus, and shall show men many things. What shall I make of you, Esdras? And will you yet plead with me? And the prophet said: Lord, I shall not cease to plead with You. And God said: Number the flowers of the earth. If you shall be able to number them, you are able also to plead with me. And the prophet said: Lord, I cannot number them. I wear human flesh; but I shall not cease to plead with You. I wish, Lord, to see also the under parts of Tartarus. And God said: Come down and see. And He gave me Michael, and Gabriel, and other thirty-four angels; and I went down eighty-five steps, and they brought me down five hundred steps, and I saw a fiery throne, and an old man sitting upon it; and his judgment was merciless. And I said to the angels: Who is this? And what is his sin? And they said to me: This is Herod, who for a time was a king, and ordered to put to death the children from two years old and under. {{BIBLE:mat 2:16}} And I said: Woe to his soul! And again they took me down thirty steps, and I there saw boilings up of fire, and in them there was a multitude of sinners; and I heard their voice, but saw not their forms. And they took me down lower many steps, which I could not measure. And I there saw old men, and fiery pivots turning in their ears. And I said: Who are these? And what is their sin? And they said to me: These are they who would not listen. And they took me down again other five hundred steps, and I there saw the worm that sleeps not, and fire burning up the sinners. And they took me down to the lowest part of destruction, and I saw there the twelve plagues of the abyss. And they took me away to the south, and I saw there a man hanging by the eyelids; and the angels kept scourging him. And I asked: Who is this? And what is his sin? And Michael the commander said to me: This is one who lay with his mother; for having put into practice a small wish, he has been ordered to be hanged. And they took me away to the north, and I saw there a man bound with iron chains. And I asked: Who is this? And he said to me: This is he who said, I am the Son of God, that made stones bread, and water wine. And the prophet said: My lord, let me know what is his form, and I shall tell the race of men, that they may not believe in him. And he said to me: The form of his countenance is like that of a wild beast; his right eye like the star that rises in the morning, and the other without motion; his mouth one cubit; his teeth span long; his fingers like scythes; the track of his feet of two spans; and in his face an inscription, Antichrist. He has been exalted to heaven; he shall go down to Hades. {{BIBLE:mat 11:23}} At one time he shall become a child; at another, an old man. And the prophet said: Lord, and how do You permit him, and he deceives the race of men? And God said: Listen, my prophet. He becomes both child and old man, and no one believes him that he is my beloved Son. And after this a trumpet, and the tombs shall be opened, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible. {{BIBLE:1co 15:52}} Then the adversary, hearing the dreadful threatening, shall be hidden in outer darkness. Then the heaven, and the earth, and the sea shall be destroyed. Then shall I burn the heaven eighty cubits, and the earth eight hundred cubits. And the prophet said: And how has the heaven sinned? And God said: Since. ..there is evil. And the prophet said: Lord, and the earth, how has it sinned? And God said: Since the adversary, having heard the dreadful threatening, shall be hidden, even on account of this will I melt the earth, and with it the opponent of the race of men. And the prophet said: Have mercy, Lord, upon the race of the Christians. And I saw a woman hanging, and four wild beasts sucking her breasts. And the angels said to me: She grudged to give her milk, but even threw her infants into the rivers. And I saw a dreadful darkness, and a night that had no stars nor moon; nor is there there young or old, nor brother with brother, nor mother with child, nor wife with husband. And I wept, and said: O Lord God, have mercy upon the sinners. And as I said this, there came a cloud and snatched me up, and carried me away again into the heavens. And I saw there many judgments; and I wept bitterly, and said: It is good for a man not to have come out of his mother's womb. And those who were in torment cried out, saying: Since you have come hither, O holy one of God, we have found a little remission. And the prophet said: Blessed are they that weep for their sins. And God said: Hear, O beloved Esdras. As a husbandman casts the seed of the grain into the ground, so also the man casts his seed into the parts of the woman. The first month it is all together; the second it increases in size; the third it gets hair; the fourth it gets nails; the fifth it is turned into milk; and the sixth it is made ready, and receives life; the seventh it is completely furnished; the ninth the barriers of the gate of the woman are opened; and it is born safe and sound into the earth. And the prophet said: Lord, it is good for man not to have been born. Woe to the human race then, when You shall come to judgment! And I said to the Lord: Lord, why have You created man, and delivered him up to judgment? And God said, with a lofty proclamation: I will not by any means have mercy on those who transgress my covenant. And the prophet said: Lord, where is Your goodness? And God said: I have prepared all things for man's sake, and man does not keep my commandments. And the prophet said: Lord, reveal to me the judgments and paradise. And the angels took me away towards the east, and I saw the tree of life. And I saw there Enoch, and Elias, and Moses, and Peter, and Paul, and Luke, and Matthias, and all the righteous, and the patriarchs. And I saw there the keeping of the air within bounds, and the blowing of the winds, and the storehouses of the ice, and the eternal judgments. And I saw there a man hanging by the skull. And they said to me: This man removed landmarks. And I saw there great judgments. And I said to the Lord: O Lord God, and what man, then, who has been born has not sinned? And they took me lower down into Tartarus, and I saw all the sinners lamenting and weeping and mourning bitterly. And I also wept, seeing the race of men thus tormented. Then God says to me: Do you know, Esdras, the names of the angels at the end of the world? Michael, Gabriel, Uriel, Raphael, Gabuthelon, Aker, Arphugitonos, Beburos, Zebuleon.

Then there came a voice to me: Come hither and die, Esdras, my beloved; give that which has been entrusted to you. And the prophet said: And whence can you bring forth my soul? And the angels said: We can put it forth through the mouth. And the prophet said: Mouth to mouth have I spoken with God, {{BIBLE:deu 34:10}} and it comes not forth thence. And the angels said: Let us bring it out through your nostrils. And the prophet said: My nostrils have smelled the sweet savour of the glory of God. And the angels said: We can bring it out through your eyes. And the prophet said: My eyes have seen the back parts of God. {{BIBLE:exo 33:23}} And the angels said: We can bring it out through the crown of your head. And the prophet said: I walked about with Moses also on the mountain, and it comes not forth thence. And the angels said: We can put it forth through the points of your nails. And the prophet said: My feet also have walked about on the altar. And the angels went away without having done anything, saying: Lord, we cannot get his soul. Then He says to His only begotten Son: Go down, my beloved Son, with a great host of angels, and take the soul of my beloved Esdras. For the Lord, having taken a great host of angels, says to the prophet: Give me the trust which I entrusted to you; the crown has been prepared for you. {{BIBLE:2ti 4:8}} And the prophet said: Lord, if Thou take my soul from me, who will be left to plead with You for the race of men? And God said: As you are mortal, and of the earth, do not plead with me. And the prophet said: I will not cease to plead. And God said: Give up just now the trust; the crown has been prepared for you. Come and die, that you may obtain it. Then the prophet began to say with tears: O Lord, what good have I done pleading with You, and I am going to fall down into the earth? Woe's me, woe's me, that I am going to be eaten up by worms! Weep, all you saints and you righteous, for me, who have pleaded much, and who am delivered up to death. Weep for me, all you saints and you righteous, because I have gone to the pit of Hades. And God said to him: Hear, Esdras, my beloved. I, who am immortal, endured a cross; I tasted vinegar and gall; I was laid in a tomb, and I raised up my chosen ones; I called Adam up out of Hades, that I might save the race of men. Do not therefore be afraid of death: for that which is from me— that is to say, the soul— goes to heaven; and that which is from the earth— that is to say, the body— goes to the earth, from which it was taken. {{BIBLE:ecc 12:7}} And the prophet said: Woe's me! woe's me! What shall I set about? What shall I do? I know not. And then the blessed Esdras began to say: O eternal God, the Maker of the whole creation, who hast measured the heaven with a span, and who holdest the earth as a handful, who ridest upon the cherubim, who took the prophet Elias to the heavens in a chariot of fire, who givest food to all flesh, whom all things dread and tremble at from the face of Your power—listen to me, who have pleaded much, and give to all who transcribe this book, and have it, and remember my name, and honour my memory, give them a blessing from heaven; and bless him in all things, as You blessed Joseph at last, and remember not his former wickedness in the day of his judgment. And as many as have not believed this book shall be burnt up like Sodom and Gomorrha. And there came to him a voice, saying: Esdras, my beloved, all things whatever you have asked will I give to each one. And immediately he gave up his precious soul with much honour, in the month of October, on the twenty-eighth. And they prepared him for burial with incense and psalms; and his precious and sacred body dispenses strength of soul and body perpetually to those who have recourse to him from a longing desire. To whom is due glory, strength, honour, and adoration,— to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and to ages of ages. Amen.

latex.p0002: \Emph{圣先知及天主所爱的厄斯德拉的圣言与默示。}
latex.p0003: 在第三十年，某月二十二日，我在家中。我向至高者呼喊说：\Quote{主，赐予光荣，使我得见祢的奥秘。}到了夜间，有一位天使，总领天使\Person{弥额尔}，来向我说：\Quote{\Person{厄斯德拉}先知，要禁食七十个\Emph{星期}。}我就照他说的禁食。又来了军旅的首领\Person{辣法耳}，给了我一根苏合香木杖。我禁食了两倍六十星期。我看见天主和祂天使的奥秘。我对他们说：\Quote{我愿在天主面前为基督徒的种族辩护。人不出生，比来到世上更好。}于是我被提到天上，在第一层天看见一大队天使；他们带我到了审判台前。我听见有声音向我说：\Quote{天主的选民\Person{厄斯德拉}，怜悯我们吧。}于是我开始说：\Quote{罪人有祸了！当他们看见一个比天使更义的人，而自己却在地狱之火中！}\Person{厄斯德拉}说：\Quote{怜悯祢手所造的，祢是慈悲而大仁大慈的。宁愿审判我，而不要审判罪人的灵魂；因为一个灵魂受罚，而全世界不至灭亡，是更好的。}天主说：\Quote{我要使义人在乐园得安息，我已发慈悲。}\Person{厄斯德拉}说：\Quote{主，祢为何施恩于义人呢？如同一个被雇的人，服完他的时间，来到他主人面前又作奴仆；同样，义人已在天上得了赏报。但求祢怜悯罪人，因为我们知道祢是仁慈的。}天主说：\Quote{我看我无法怜悯他们。}\Person{厄斯德拉}说：\Quote{他们不能忍受祢的忿怒。}天主说：\Quote{这便是这样人的\Emph{命运}。}天主说：\Quote{我愿意使你像\Person{保禄}和\Person{若望}一样，因为你们给了我无可偷盗、完整无损的宝藏，就是贞洁的宝藏，人类的保障。}\Person{厄斯德拉}说：\Quote{人不出生更好，不在世上更好。无理性的\Emph{受造物}比人更好，因为它们不受惩罚；但祢却取了我们，把我们交予审判。来世的罪人有祸了！因为他们的审判无尽，火焰不灭。}我正这样对祂说话时，\Person{弥额尔}、\Person{加俾额尔}和所有宗徒来了；他们说：\Quote{天主的忠信之人，喜乐吧！}\Person{厄斯德拉}说：\Quote{主，起来，与我同来审判。}主说：\Quote{看，我给你我的盟约，在我与你之间，使你能领受。}\Person{厄斯德拉}说：\Quote{让我们在祢的听觉中争辩。}天主说：\Quote{去问你的父亲\Person{亚巴郎}，儿子怎样与父亲争辩，然后来与我们争辩。}\Person{厄斯德拉}说：\Quote{主永在，我不停止为基督徒的种族与祢争辩。主，祢古时的慈悲在哪里？祢的宽容在哪里？}天主说：\Quote{我造了黑夜和白昼，也造了义人和罪人；他本该像义人一样生活。}先知说：\Quote{谁造了原造的\Person{亚当}？}天主说：\Quote{我无玷的双手。我把他放在乐园里，看守生命树的果子；此后他成了悖逆的，犯了罪做了这事。}先知说：\Quote{他岂不是由一位天使保护吗？他的生命岂不是由革鲁宾保守直到无尽世代？那被天使保护的人怎么就被欺骗了？因为祢命令众人都要在场，聆听祢所说的。但若祢没有给他\Person{厄娃}，蛇就不会欺骗她；但祢愿意救谁就救谁，愿意毁灭谁就毁灭谁。}先知说：\Quote{我主，让我们来第二次审判。}天主说：\Quote{我把火降在\Place{索多玛}和\Place{哈摩辣}上。}先知说：\Quote{主，祢按我们的罪过对待我们。}天主说：\Quote{你们的罪过超越我的仁慈。}先知说：\Quote{我的父，请记念圣经，祢曾测量了\Place{耶路撒冷}，又重建了她。主，求祢怜悯罪人；怜悯祢自己的受造物；怜恤祢的工程。}于是天主记起了祂所造的人，对先知说：\Quote{我怎能怜悯他们？他们给我喝醋和苦胆，\BibleRef{玛 27:34}即使那时他们也不悔改。}先知说：\Quote{启示祢的革鲁宾，让我们一同去审判；给我显示审判之日是怎样的。}天主说：\Quote{\Person{厄斯德拉}，你被欺骗了；因为审判之日如同地上没有雨水一样；比起那日子，这是一个仁慈的审判庭。}先知说：\Quote{除非我看见终结之日，我不停止与祢争辩。}天主说：\Quote{数算星辰和海沙；如果你能数算这些，你就能与我争辩。}先知说：\Quote{主，祢知道我具有血肉之躯；我怎能数算天上的星辰和海沙？}天主说：\Quote{我的特选先知，没有人知道那大日子和那来审判世界的显现。为你的缘故，我的先知，我告诉了你那日子，但时辰我没有告诉你。}先知说：\Quote{主，也请告诉我那年限。}天主说：\Quote{若我看见世界的义德增多，我就容忍他们；否则，我要伸手，抓住世界的四极，将他们全部聚集在\Place{约沙法特}山谷，我要消灭人类种族，使世界不再存在。}先知说：\Quote{祢的右手怎能得荣耀？}天主说：\Quote{我将由我的天使得荣耀。}先知说：\Quote{主，若祢已决定这样做，为何祢造人？祢曾向我们的父亲\Person{亚巴郎}说：\BibleRef{创 22:17}\InnerQuote{我必多多增益你的后裔，如同天上的星辰和海边的沙粒。}祢的应许在哪里？}天主说：\Quote{我先要使地震，使四足兽和人跌倒；当你看见弟兄把弟兄交于死地，儿女起来反抗父母，妻子离弃自己的丈夫，民族起来攻击民族交战，那时你就知道结局近了。}\EditorialNote{玛窦福音第廿四章}
latex.p0004: 因为那时兄弟不怜恤兄弟，丈夫不怜恤妻子，孩子不怜恤父母，朋友不怜恤朋友，奴仆不怜恤主人；因为人类的仇敌要从\OriginalTerm{塔尔塔罗斯}{Tartarus}上来，向人显示许多事。我该怎样处置你，厄斯德拉？你还想与我辩论吗？先知说：\Quote{主，我不会停止与祢辩论。}天主说：\Quote{数算大地上的花朵。你若能数算它们，你也能与我辩论。}先知说：\Quote{主，我不能数算\Emph{它们}。我穿着人的血肉，但我不会停止与祢辩论。主，我也愿意看见塔尔塔罗斯的底部。}天主说：\Quote{下来看吧。}祂赐给我\Person{弥额尔}、\Person{加俾额尔}和其他三十四位天使；我下了八十五级台阶，他们带我下了五百级台阶，我看见一个火红的宝座，一位老人坐在上面；他的审判毫无怜悯。我问天使们：\Quote{这是谁？他有什么罪？}他们对我说：\Quote{这是\Person{黑落德}，他曾作王一时，下令将两岁及以下的婴孩处死。}\BibleRef{玛 2:16}我说：\Quote{他的灵魂有祸了！}他们又带我下了三十级台阶，我在那里看见火沸腾，其中有\Emph{有}一大群罪人；我听见他们的声音，却看不见他们的形状。他们带我下了许多级台阶，我无法测量。我在那里看见许多老人，火热的转轮在他们的耳朵里转动。我说：\Quote{这些人是谁？他们有什么罪？}他们对我说：\Quote{这些是不肯听的人。}他们又带我下了五百级台阶，我在那里看见了不睡的虫和焚烧罪人的火。他们带我下到毁灭的最低处，我在那里看见了深渊的十二灾祸。他们带我到南方，我在那里看见一个人被吊着眼皮，天使们不断鞭打他。我问：\Quote{这是谁？他有什么罪？}军长\Person{弥额尔}对我说：\Quote{这是与他母亲同寝的人；因实践了一个小愿望，他被下令吊起来。}他们带我到北方，我在那里看见一个人被铁链捆绑。我问：\Quote{这是谁？}他对我说：\Quote{这是那曾说过\InnerQuote{我是天主子，能使石头变成饼，水变成酒}的人。}先知说：\Quote{我主，请让我知道他的形状，我好告诉人类，叫他们不要信从他。}他对我说：\Quote{他的面容形状如同野兽；他的右眼如同早晨升起的星，另一只眼不动；他的口有一肘长；他的牙齿有一掌长；他的手指如同镰刀；他的脚掌有两掌长；他的脸上有字样：\OriginalTerm{假基督}{Antichrist}。他曾被高举到天上；他必下到阴府。}\BibleRef{玛 11:23}他一时成为孩童，一时又成为老人。先知说：\Quote{主，祢怎会允许他欺骗人类呢？}天主说：\Quote{听啊，我的先知。他既成为孩童又成为老人，没有人相信他是我的爱子。此后，号角一响，坟墓将要打开，死人必要复活，成为不朽坏的。}\BibleRef{格前 15:52}那时，那敌对者听见可怕的威胁，必隐藏在外面的黑暗里。然后，天、地、海都要被毁灭。那时我要焚烧天八十肘，地八百肘。先知说：\Quote{天犯了什么罪？}天主说：\Quote{因为……有邪恶。}先知说：\Quote{主，地又犯了什么罪？}天主说：\Quote{因为那敌对者听见可怕的威胁，将要隐藏，因此我也要熔化大地，连同那与人类为敌的一起。}先知说：\Quote{主，求祢怜悯基督徒的子民。}我看见一个女人被悬挂着，四只野兽吮吸她的乳房。天使对我说：\Quote{她吝啬不肯给奶，甚至把她的婴孩扔进河里。}我看见可怕的黑暗，没有星也没有月的夜晚；那里没有少壮或年老，没有兄弟与兄弟，没有母亲与孩子，没有妻子与丈夫。我哭泣说：\Quote{主天主啊，求祢怜悯罪人。}我说这话时，有一片云彩来把我攫去，又带我回到天上。我在那里看见许多审判；我痛哭流涕说：\Quote{人不出母腹更好。}那些在痛苦中的人呼喊说：\Quote{因为你来了，天主的圣者，我们得到了一点缓解。}先知说：\Quote{哀哭自己罪过的人是有福的。}天主说：\Quote{听啊，亲爱的厄斯德拉。如同农夫将谷种撒入地里，人也把种子撒入妇女的产道。第一个\Emph{月}它结合为一；第二个月它增大；第三个月长出毛发；第四个月长出指甲；第五个月变成奶；第六个月预备好，接受生命；第七个月完全形成；第九个月妇女产门的屏障打开；它安全稳妥地出生到地上。}先知说：\Quote{主，人不出生更好。那时人类有祸了，当祢来审判的时候！}我对主说：\Quote{主，祢为什么造人，又把他交付审判？}天主用庄严的宣告说：\Quote{我绝不会怜悯那些违背我盟约的人。}先知说：\Quote{主，祢的良善在哪里？}天主说：\Quote{我为人的缘故预备了一切，但人不遵守我的诫命。}先知说：\Quote{主，求祢向我启示审判和乐园。}天使带我往东去，我看见生命树。我在那里看见\Person{哈诺客}、\Person{厄里亚}、\Person{梅瑟}、\Person{伯多禄}、\Person{保禄}、\Person{路加}、\Person{玛弟亚}和所有义人及圣祖们。我在那里看见被约束的空气、风的吹动、冰的库房和永恒的审判。我在那里看见一个人被吊着头骨。他们对我说：\Quote{这个人挪移了地界。}我在那里看见许多大审判。我对主说：\Quote{主天主啊，那么有哪个出生的人没有犯过罪呢？}他们带我下到更深处的塔尔塔罗斯，我看见所有罪人在哀叹、哭泣、悲恸。我也哭了，看见人类如此受折磨。然后天主对我说：\Quote{厄斯德拉，你知道世界末日的天使名字吗？\Person{弥额尔}、\Person{加俾额尔}、\Person{乌黎耳}、\Person{辣法耳}、\Person{加布泰隆}、\Person{阿克尔}、\Person{阿尔普吉托诺斯}、\Person{贝布罗斯}、\Person{则步隆}。}
latex.p0005: \Quote{然后有声音对我说：前来，死去，\Person{厄斯德拉}，我的爱者；将托付给你的交出来。}先知说：\Quote{你们从哪里取出我的灵魂？}天使说：\Quote{我们可以从口中取出来。}先知说：\Quote{我曾与天主面对面说话\BibleRef{申 34:10}，不能从那里出来。}天使说：\Quote{让我们从你的鼻孔取出。}先知说：\Quote{我的鼻孔已闻过天主荣耀的馨香。}天使说：\Quote{我们可以从你的眼睛取出。}先知说：\Quote{我的眼睛曾见过天主的后背\BibleRef{出 33:23}。}天使说：\Quote{我们可以从你的头顶取出。}先知说：\Quote{我也曾与\Person{梅瑟}在山上行走，不能从那里出来。}天使说：\Quote{我们可以从你的指甲尖取出。}先知说：\Quote{我的脚也曾行走在祭台上。}天使一无所成地离去，说：\Quote{主，我们无法取得他的灵魂。}然后祂对祂的独生子说：\Quote{下去，我的爱子，与一大队天使，取走我的爱子\Person{厄斯德拉}的灵魂。}因为主取了一大队天使，对先知说：\Quote{将我所托付给你的寄托之物还给我；冠冕已为你预备\BibleRef{弟后 4:8}。}先知说：\Quote{主，若祢从我取走灵魂，谁还能留下为人类向祢恳求？}天主说：\Quote{你既是必死的属尘土之人，不要向我恳求。}先知说：\Quote{我不停止恳求。}天主说：\Quote{现在就交出寄托之物；冠冕已为你预备。前来死去，好得到它。}先知含泪开始说：\Quote{啊，主，我向祢恳求做了什么好事，我将要倒在地上？呜呼！呜呼！我竟要被虫吃掉了！众圣人和义人啊，为我哭泣，我恳求了许多，却被交于死亡。众圣人和义人啊，为我哭泣，因我已进入冥府的深渊。}天主对他说：\Quote{听着，\Person{厄斯德拉}，我的爱者。我，不死的，忍受了十字架；我尝了醋和苦胆；被放在坟墓里，并复活了我的选民；我从冥府召唤了\Person{亚当}上来，为要\Emph{拯救}人类。因此不要怕死亡：因为那从我而来的——即灵魂——去到天堂；那从土而来的——即身体——归回它所出的土\BibleRef{训 12:7}。}先知说：\Quote{呜呼！呜呼！我将如何着手？我该做什么？我不知道。}然后有福的\Person{厄斯德拉}开始说：\Quote{啊，永恒的天主，万有的创造者，祢用手掌量了诸天，用手捧了大地，乘着革鲁宾，用火马车将先知\Person{厄里亚}带到天堂，养活着一切有血肉的，万有在祢的威能面前无不战栗——请听我，我恳求了许多，并赏给所有抄写本书、拥有它、记念我名字、尊敬我纪念的人，从天堂降福给他们；在一切事上祝福他，如同祢最终祝福了\Person{若瑟}，并在审判之日不再记念他先前的邪恶。凡不信此书的人，必像\Place{索多玛}和\Place{哈摩辣}一样被烧毁。}有声音对他说：\Quote{\Person{厄斯德拉}，我的爱者，凡你所求的一切，我都赐给每个人。}他立即极其尊贵地交出了宝贵的灵魂，在十月二十八日。他们用香料和圣咏为他准备埋葬；他宝贵而神圣的身体，永远赐给那些怀着渴望投奔他的人灵魂和身体的力量。愿光荣、权能、尊荣、朝拜归于祂——归于圣父、圣子及圣神，从今直到永远，永世无穷。阿们。
